# Camrhia

> Camrhia is an iOS app and website platform for photographers. It gives photographers a live portfolio website, a marketplace where couples browse photographers in their area, bookings and sessions, contracts, payment tracking, client messaging, a calendar and gallery link delivery, all in one app. Photographers can try it free for 14 days.

## Key facts
- Built for photographers: weddings, portraits, newborns, families and events.
- Available on the Apple App Store (iOS).
- Photographer plans: Solo at $59.99 per month or $590 per year, and Studio at $149 per month or $999.99 per year. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
- The portfolio website is included with the subscription.
- Free for clients: couples browse photographers in their area and manage their session, payments, messages and photos in the app.
- Camrhia does not host galleries. Photographers keep using Pixieset, ShootProof, Google Drive or similar, and Camrhia delivers the link inside the client's app.
- Camrhia also runs an affiliate program that pays 20 to 30 percent recurring commission on referred photographers.
